name: Darkened Bank
summary: At Duskwood’s northern edge, Darkened Bank runs beside Elwynn Forest. Its shore reaches east toward the Redridge Mountains, between safer ground and the forest’s terrors.

sections.title: A Precarious Boundary
sections.body: Darkened Bank follows the river that divides Duskwood from Elwynn Forest. Its shore stretches from the western bends to the stone span leading to the Redridge Mountains. Beneath Duskwood’s gloomy canopy, travelers coming south from Elwynn often reach this ground first. Near the western tip, a makeshift camp shelters the displaced Sven Yorgen and Lars, just beyond the deep woods.

faq.q: Where is the Darkened Bank located?
faq.answer: Darkened Bank follows Duskwood’s northern shore along the river, opposite Elwynn Forest. It runs from the zone’s far west to the bridge crossing into the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Who lives along the Darkened Bank?
faq.answer: A modest refuge camp at the far western edge shelters Sven Yorgen and Lars. Driven from their former lives deeper in the territory, they use the riverbank as a fragile haven while seeking aid against Duskwood’s threats.

faq.q: How do travelers usually reach this area?
aliases: how to get to darkened bank
faq.answer: You can reach the western shore by swimming south across the river from southwestern Elwynn Forest. Or follow the southern riverbank west from the Redridge bridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer leaving Elwynn Forest, you can stop first at Darkened Bank before heading deeper into Duskwood’s haunted heart.
